CONTROL & TRANSPARENCY

Settings & privacy

Understand how this app handles documents and what it can — and cannot — do.

Document processing

PDF text extraction and OCR run in your browser. When you request an AI Summary, extracted document text is securely sent to the AI service to generate the explanation.

Browser + AI
Data retention

Document text and checklist state remain in this page session. When you request an AI Summary, extracted document text is sent securely to the AI service for processing. Third-party CDN requests load required libraries, fonts, and OCR language data.

Session only
Clear current document

Remove the active document, extracted text, requirements, and checklist from the current session.

Known limitations

OCR can misread numbers, tables, handwriting, stamps, and checkboxes. Automated highlights and requirement detection are heuristic. Search results are not generated answers. Official deadlines and eligibility are not independently verified.
